note: FIELD DRIVE, not a bench sweep — the input plan 091 waited for. The user drove one continuous session on 2026-08-02 (dev server, Vite on :5177, ?loader=http-dir&src=.../build/original/opensa&hour=12&weather=0) in a `comet`: Ganton -> Downtown LS -> city centre -> the freeway overpass -> the whole countryside -> the desert -> the whole of Las Venturas. Route chosen to cross LA/COUNTRYSIDE/DESERT/VEGAS, the only popcycle zone-types that differ for random map-car resolution (CITY_POPCYCLE_ZONE maps all three cities to RESIDENTIAL_AVERAGE). Schema differs from the `[bench]` family on purpose: this is a census of the `[slow]` lines the game prints itself for every frame over 20 ms (perfLogs = IS_DEV), not a scripted sweep, so there are no per-scene rows. Parsed from the browser console export `localhost-1785656678713.log`. THE GAPS: the console was opened after boot, so the log carries NO pak buildTime line — the pak is `build/original/opensa` as it stood on 2026-08-02 (data rebaked 2026-07-31) but that is inferred, not recorded; the export has no timestamps, so the drive's duration is unknown; and this is a DEV build, which the `[bench]` series is not. Machine: the user's dev host (the series' M3 Pro), DPR not recorded. RE-DRIVE OWED: the run predates the parked-car fixes of 2026-08-02 (lazy registration, spawn gated on the collision radius, respawn anchored to the placement), so its car population is not comparable with any later run.

spans.comment: ZERO vehicle spans over 223 slow frames -- and this is NOT the verdict it looks like. The driver met parked cars exactly ONCE in the whole route: `parked.json` (212 placements, 24 models) is the only car population that exists and it is all spawned at boot, and plan 059's ~1043 map car generators are implemented but wired to nothing (`mapCarGenerators()` is called only by its own unit test). The drive could not meet a new car type, so this count measures the world's emptiness, not the cost of a spawn. 091's per-type branch stays OPEN.

accountingDefect.comment: `cell-collision-read` is subtracted twice: it runs synchronously inside `collision.update()`, which the loop already times as the `collision` block. Exactly the trap 091 avoided for `cell-create`/`texture-upload`. Only visible as a negative number.

fieldReport.bug: parked cars spawn on a lot, then do not respawn after leaving and re-entering (empty lot) -- ROOT-CAUSED AND FIXED 2026-08-02, see docs/open-issues/fixed/parked-cars-do-not-respawn.md. A car spawned past the collision radius free-falls, and the LOD system measured its unload distance from wherever it fell, so the spot never repopulated. This run was taken BEFORE the fix; a re-drive is owed.
